summary: Silo Pharma filed an 8-K disclosing an October 1, 2026 asset purchase agreement with Norsight Consulting Inc., an Arkansas corporation, to acquire software, technology and related IP including trademarks, domain names, data and trade secrets. Consideration is a warrant for up to 300,000 shares at $1.51 per share with cashless exercise, exercisable from April 1, 2027 through September 30, 2031, subject to a 4.99% blocker (up to 9.99% on 61 days notice) and a 12-month lock-up. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch dilution and overhang risk.
